name: Film and TV
description: The films and TV shows the world has watched, from the first moving pictures and Hollywood's golden age to blockbusters, cable dramas and streaming.

checkpoints.name: The first films
checkpoints.note: Edison and the Lumière brothers show the first moving pictures, and Méliès sends a rocket to the Moon on film.

checkpoints.name: Silent films
checkpoints.note: Hollywood becomes the home of film. Chaplin and Keaton make the world laugh, and Germany and the Soviet Union make films as art.

checkpoints.name: Hollywood's golden age
checkpoints.note: Sound arrives, and the studios make Gone with the Wind, The Wizard of Oz, Snow White and Citizen Kane. The first television services begin.

checkpoints.name: World cinema and the first TV hits
checkpoints.note: Television enters the home with shows like I Love Lucy. Kurosawa, Fellini and the French New Wave remake cinema, and Hitchcock and Kubrick push its limits.

checkpoints.name: Blockbusters
checkpoints.note: The Godfather, Jaws and Star Wars change Hollywood. Television brings soap operas, sitcoms and the first music videos.

checkpoints.name: The digital era
checkpoints.note: Computer animation arrives with Toy Story, Titanic breaks records and cable dramas like The Sopranos make television an art.

checkpoints.name: The streaming age
checkpoints.note: Netflix and other services stream films and series to the world. Superhero films top the box office, and shows from Korea and Spain become global hits.
